list.name: perWorker
list.label: UCM view
list.query: Per worker : job\, instance\, model_name\, worker_id,Per instance : job\, instance\, model_name

options.content: SGLang native HiCache metrics. L2 is device ↔ host; L3 is host ↔ storage. Native cache metrics use tp_rank / pp_rank / dp_rank, not UCM worker_id. Rank filters below apply here; model_name and UCM worker_id do not filter native cache collectors. Keep token counts per rank to avoid multiplying logical tokens by TP size. UCM connector rows use worker_id/model_name and read ucm:sglang_connector_* directly; they do not use HiCache get_stats(). Successful pool-call pages and GB/s are distinct from attempt durations (including errors). V2 counts are per pool, not unique logical pages across pools.

panels.title: prefetched_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Prompt tokens successfully transferred from L3 storage into host memory, before admission-time reuse or discard.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}prefetched_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: backuped_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Number of backuped tokens.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}backuped_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: storage_prefetch_hit_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Storage-hit tokens returned by an L3 query before host allocation, transfer, or cache insertion.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}storage_prefetch_hit_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: storage_prefetch_unfulfilled_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Attempt-level storage-hit tokens that did not become a usable prefetch result, by diagnostic reason. This is not a final prefill cache-miss counter. anchor_lost means the original device prefix was no longer present when the prefetch needed it; aux_window_trim means a staged aux trailing window could not be trimmed to the shorter splice, so the loaded span was released; device_overlap means the live device prefix diverged from the request's view at splice time, so the span beyond it was released; cache_admission_shortfall means an L3-loaded L2 span was no longer reusable when cache-mode admission ran; deadline means the storage prefetch stop policy ended the read before it completed.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}storage_prefetch_unfulfilled_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: storage_prefetch_deferred_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Storage-prefetch token-attempts deferred for later reuse, by transient capacity reason.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}storage_prefetch_deferred_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: hicache_backup_dropped_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Buffer-mode backup tokens that never reached L3 because admission rejected them or the source became stale before the D2H staging launched; the write path lagging device churn is the common cause, and the span rewrites only on a later recompute.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_dropped_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: hicache_prefetch_aux_alloc_failed_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
Prefetch tokens abandoned because an aux pool (e.g. the SWA trailing window) could not allocate host staging — the whole storage fetch is forfeited, not just the aux part.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_prefetch_aux_alloc_failed_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: eviction_duration_seconds / distribution
panels.description:
End-to-end time of a device eviction pass in seconds; under --hicache-write-policy write_back this includes the blocking D->H backup (see sglang:hicache_backup_duration_seconds for the copy alone).

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}eviction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}eviction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}eviction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: evicted_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
The number of device KV token slots freed by eviction, regardless of whether the data was backed up to host (see sglang:hicache_backup_tokens_total) or destroyed (see sglang:hicache_dropped_tokens_total).

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}evicted_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}load_back_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}load_back_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}load_back_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: load_back_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
The number of tokens loaded back from local host DRAM (L2) to GPU, by host pool (kv, swa, mamba, ...). Every TP rank reports the same logical count under its own rank labels; read one rank rather than summing ranks.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}load_back_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: hicache_backup_duration_seconds / distribution
panels.description:
Time taken to back up KV cache from GPU to local host DRAM (L2) in seconds, per merged write op. Covers all D->H backups regardless of --hicache-write-policy. Distinct from the host-to-storage (L3) sglang:backuped_tokens_total.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: hicache_backup_bytes_total / rate
panels.description:
Bytes backed up from GPU to local host DRAM (L2), all pools combined, including draft/sidecar transfers that the token counter excludes. Each rank reports its own KV shard; sum ranks for the physical total. A window's byte delta divided by the same window's hicache_backup_duration_seconds sum is the bytes-weighted active bandwidth; the plain rate is wall-clock payload traffic that includes idle time.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_bytes_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: load_back_bytes_total / rate
panels.description:
Bytes loaded back from local host DRAM (L2) to GPU, all pools combined, including draft/sidecar transfers that the token counter excludes. Each rank reports its own KV shard; sum ranks for the physical total. A window's byte delta divided by the same window's load_back_duration_seconds sum is the bytes-weighted active bandwidth; the plain rate is wall-clock payload traffic that includes idle time.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}load_back_bytes_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: hicache_backup_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
The number of tokens backed up from GPU to local host DRAM (L2), by host pool (kv, swa, mamba, ...). Covers all D->H backups regardless of --hicache-write-policy. Distinct from the host-to-storage (L3) sglang:backuped_tokens_total. Every TP rank reports the same logical count under its own rank labels; read one rank rather than summing ranks.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_backup_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: hicache_dropped_tokens_total / rate
panels.description:
The number of logical device KV tokens destroyed without a host backup. The pool label is always kv; reason is host_pressure for write-back failure, or write_through_unbacked_eviction when eager write-through did not complete before eviction.

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, tp_rank, pp_rank, dp_rank, pool, reason, storage_backend, cache_type) (rate(${sglang_prefix}hicache_dropped_tokens_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HiCache cumulative counter
panels.description: Cumulative samples per rank; logical token counts must not be summed across TP ranks.

targets.expr: {__name__=~"${sglang_prefix}(prefetched_tokens_total|backuped_tokens_total|storage_prefetch_hit_tokens_total|storage_prefetch_unfulfilled_tokens_total|storage_prefetch_deferred_tokens_total|hicache_backup_dropped_tokens_total|hicache_prefetch_aux_alloc_failed_tokens_total|evicted_tokens_total|load_back_tokens_total|hicache_backup_bytes_total|load_back_bytes_total|hicache_backup_tokens_total|hicache_dropped_tokens_total)",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}

panels.title: HiCache cumulative histogram
panels.description: Cumulative samples per rank; logical token counts must not be summed across TP ranks.

targets.expr: {__name__=~"${sglang_prefix}(eviction_duration_seconds_count|load_back_duration_seconds_count|hicache_backup_duration_seconds_count)",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",tp_rank=~"$tp_rank",pp_rank=~"$pp_rank",dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"}
